ideas.title: Football with the sun
ideas.critique: The friends kicking it about will most likely play as a scripted wander that bumps the ball, and in raster one point light with no real shadows will look flat. The strong part is that the island's only light can be kicked, so every shadow swings and a whole side of the island goes into dusk. Someone would want to try that themselves as Lumi, and the traced pond lit from inside is a shot a game engine can't fake.

ideas.title: One tickle, the whole island laughing
ideas.critique: A state that passes from friend to friend is the shape of A word goes round, and a laugh pose and sound per species will most likely read as one canned clip each, with the last grump cracking on cue. Touch with a feather from the player and a spread that follows real distance and real friendships is direct play the island lacks, but it only lands if the wave moves in a way nobody scripted.

ideas.title: A glass ball that writes the sun's day
ideas.critique: A unidirectional path tracer cannot carry a delta sun through a glass sphere onto diffuse grass, so the 'real caustic' will most likely be noise or a painted decal, and then it is a fake. The idea is a persistent scorch that writes the sun's real path day after day, and a meadow that fills up with days is good. The friends jumping 'HOT!' and the toasting are scripted reactions you watch once.

ideas.title: Ride-along: they stole the camera
ideas.critique: This is round 2's They stole the camera with a lens tint added per species. It is still a view with a life of its own, like the bored camera, and keep-away will most likely be one scripted pass from friend to friend. A carried view that takes on each species' gait, with fog and jelly refraction through a real glass plane in the tracer, is new. A bouncing handheld view is also tiring to watch for long.

ideas.title: You are the wind
ideas.critique: Hats blowing off and friends leaning into it are the expected beats, and waves on the pond come close to the human's own splash example. A velocity field stirred by the player's drag that moves creatures, sand, props and water together is new physics that answers the hand at once. Because what got blown away stays where it landed, people will come back to it, as long as the forces feel physical and not like a push per object.
